Description: Skills that spend Fervour have +4% increased Critical Strike Chance per point.

Name: SoulCollector_basic_d_a2
Description: Skills that spend Fervour deal +3% increased damage per point against Elite and stronger creatures.

Name: SoulCollector_keystone_d_kA
Description: Spending 10 or more Fervour at once releases a blast dealing damage for each Fervour spent. The blast deals 10% of your weapon damage for each Fervour spent to every enemy within 5 metres.

Name: SoulCollector_basic_d_b0
Description: You take 1% reduced damage per point for 4 seconds after you spend Fervour.

Name: SoulCollector_basic_d_b1
Description: Spending Fervour restores 1% of your maximum mana per point for every 10 Fervour spent.

Name: SoulCollector_basic_d_b2
Description: Spending Fervour restores 1% of your Maximum Energy Shield per point for every 10 Fervour spent.

Name: SoulCollector_keystone_d_kB
Description: Spending Fervour heals 1% of maximum health for each Fervour spent.

Name: SoulCollector_basic_d_c0
Description: Fervour you hold back for a minion, gadget or trap counts as Fervour spent, at 15% per point of what is held back.

Name: SoulCollector_basic_d_c1
Description: 3% per point of the Fervour you spend returns to you 4 seconds later.

Name: SoulCollector_keystone_d_kC
Description: Every 10 Fervour you spend takes 1 second off the cooldowns of your skills that did not spend it.

Name: Necromancer_basic_spine_000
Description: Deaths around you generate Fervour: 1 each time an enemy dies within 10 metres of you or to one of your minions. While you have this, Fervour does not decay, so what you hold is held until you spend it or your minions reserve it.

Name: Necromancer_basic_spine_001
Description: +2% increased maximum Fervour per point. Every minion holds back its share of the pool while it stands, so the pool is the size of your army.

Name: Necromancer_basic_spine_002
Description: +3% increased Fervour gained from enemies dying near you or to your minions per point.

Name: Necromancer_basic_spine_003
Description: +1% increased Minion Damage and +1% increased Minion Health per point, for every minion you raise, the ones that stay and the ones that last seconds.

Name: Necromancer_basic_spine_004
Description: Your minions' hits have a 4% chance per point to inflict Necrosis.

Name: Necromancer_basic_spine_005
Description: +1% increased Maximum Health per point, and +1% increased Armor per point while three or more of your minions are within 6 metres of you.

Name: Necromancer_basic_spine_006
Description: +3% increased cooldown recovery speed of your summon skills per point.

Name: Necromancer_basic_spine_007
Description: +2% increased Fervour gained per point, from every source.

Name: Necromancer_basic_spine_008
Description: +1% increased Minion Damage per point for every 5 minions you have, up to 25 minions.

Name: Necromancer_basic_spine_009
Description: +2% increased maximum Fervour per point.

Name: Necromancer_basic_spine_010
Description: Each enemy your permanent minions kill has a 3% chance per point to rise where it fell as a husk that lasts 8 seconds, if your Fervour has room for it.

Name: Necromancer_keystone_spine_001
Description: When one of your minions that was not raised from the dead dies, such as a thrall, an imp or a minion an item gives you, it rises where it fell as a husk that lasts 8 seconds, as large as it was, if your Fervour has room for it. A minion that has risen this way does not rise again.

Name: Necromancer_keystone_spine_002
Description: Every hit your minions land inflicts Necrosis, and your minions deal 15% more damage to enemies that have Necrosis.

Name: Necromancer_keystone_spine_003
Description: Every enemy your permanent minions kill rises where it fell as a husk that lasts 8 seconds, if your Fervour has room for it.

Name: Necromancer_basic_lg_stem0
Description: Your permanent minions have +3% increased damage and +3% increased health per point.

Name: Necromancer_basic_lg_stem1
Description: Using a summon skill when your Fervour has no room for another permanent minion restores 10% per point of the health of your most wounded permanent minion, rather than raising nothing.

Name: Necromancer_basic_lg_stem2
Description: +2% increased Minion Damage per point for each kind of minion you have beyond the first. Every type of minion is its own kind: a Barrow Guard, a shade, a husk, a thrall, an imp and each kind an item gives you are all different kinds.

Name: Necromancer_basic_lg_a0
Description: Each of your permanent minions deals +1% increased damage per point for every full 30 seconds it has stood, up to 4 times.

Name: Necromancer_basic_lg_a1
Description: Your permanent minion with the most maximum health has +4% increased damage and +4% increased health per point.

Name: Necromancer_basic_lg_a2
Description: Your permanent minions add 4% per point of your critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier to their own.

Name: Necromancer_basic_lg_b0
Description: Your permanent minions reserve 2% reduced Fervour per point.

Name: Necromancer_basic_lg_b1
Description: Each of your permanent minions that dies has a 4% chance per point to rise again where it fell 3 seconds later, if your Fervour has room for it.

Name: Necromancer_basic_lg_b2
Description: Each permanent minion you raise has a 4% chance per point to raise a second one beside it, if your Fervour has room for it.

Name: Necromancer_basic_lg_c0
Description: Your permanent minions regenerate 1% of their maximum health per second for every 2 points.

Name: Necromancer_basic_lg_c1
Description: Your permanent minions take 3% reduced damage per point while they are within 8 metres of you.

Name: Necromancer_keystone_lg_kA
Description: Your permanent minions reserve 300% more Fervour and have 400% more health and damage.

Name: Necromancer_keystone_lg_kB
Description: Your summon skills raise 2 more permanent minions each time they raise any, if your Fervour has room for them.

Name: Necromancer_keystone_lg_kC
Description: Your minions take 30% less damage.

Name: Necromancer_basic_ch_stem0
Description: Your weapon skills that land on one of your own minions detonate it, whatever kind it is.

Name: Necromancer_basic_ch_stem1
Description: A minion of yours that is released to make room for another detonates as it goes, with the radius and damage of the skill that raised it. Your minions' detonations have +2% increased area and deal +2% increased damage per point.

Name: Necromancer_basic_ch_stem2
Description: Each time a summon skill raises minions, it has an 8% chance per point to raise one more.

Name: Necromancer_basic_ch_a0
Description: A minion's detonation deals +1% increased damage per point for each other minion of yours within 3 metres of it, up to 5.

Name: Necromancer_basic_ch_a1
Description: A minion's detonation leaves rotting ground for 1 second for every 2 points, dealing 10% of the detonation's damage each second to enemies standing in it.

Name: Necromancer_basic_ch_a2
Description: A minion's detonation deals +1% increased damage per point for each detonation of yours in the last 2 seconds, of a minion or of remains, up to 5.

Name: Necromancer_basic_ch_b0
Description: Your minions have +2% increased Movement Speed and +2% increased Attack Speed per point.

Name: Necromancer_basic_ch_b1
Description: A minion's detonation deals +1% increased damage per point for each full second it has stood, up to 5 seconds.

Name: Necromancer_basic_ch_b2
Description: A minion of yours whose lifespan ends without being detonated has a 10% chance per point to explode anyway, for full damage, so at 10 points every one does.

Name: Necromancer_basic_ch_c0
Description: +3% increased Fervour gained from enemies dying near you or to your minions per point.

Name: Necromancer_basic_ch_c1
Description: Your minions reserve 4% reduced Fervour per point.

Name: Necromancer_keystone_ch_kA
Description: Detonating a minion detonates every other minion of yours within 3 metres, each for 40% damage.

Name: Necromancer_keystone_ch_kC
Description: When one of your minions is detonated, you gain Fervour equal to twice what it reserved.

Name: Necromancer_basic_os_stem0
Description: Dead creatures leave remains: a small marker where each one fell, lasting 10 seconds, which only you see. Each minion you raise on remains generates 3 Fervour. Without this keystone, or the Bone Colossus vow, no remains appear.

Name: Necromancer_basic_os_stem1
Description: Your weapon skills that land on remains detonate them, dealing 1% for every 2 points of the dead creature's maximum health to enemies within 3 metres. +1% increased Armor for every 2 points for each creature's remains within 6 metres of you, up to 10.

Name: Necromancer_basic_os_stem2
Description: A minion raised on remains consumes them and has +5% increased damage and +5% increased health per point.

Name: Necromancer_basic_os_a0
Description: A minion your summon skill raises within 1 metre per point of remains is raised on them.

Name: Necromancer_basic_os_a1
Description: Your Abomination rises sooner: each point takes 2 off the percentage of a floor's starting creatures you must kill, from 50% down to 34% at 8 points. Remains last 25% longer per point, so at 8 points they last three times as long: 30 seconds rather than 10.

Name: Necromancer_basic_os_a2
Description: Each of your minions that dies without being detonated has a 6% chance per point to leave remains.

Name: Necromancer_basic_os_b0
Description: Minions raised on remains reserve 4% reduced Fervour per point.

Name: Necromancer_basic_os_b1
Description: Consuming remains, by raising a minion on them or by detonating them, restores 1% of your maximum health for every 3 points.

Name: Necromancer_basic_os_b2
Description: Raising a minion on remains has a 4% chance per point not to consume them.

Name: Necromancer_basic_os_c0
Description: Detonated remains deal +2% increased damage per point for each ailment their creature died with.

Name: Necromancer_basic_os_c1
Description: Detonated remains have a 6% chance per point to inflict Necrosis on each enemy they hit.

Name: Necromancer_keystone_os_kB
Description: Raising a minion on remains refunds 5 Fervour: you gain 5, on top of the 3 Bone Fuse gives for the raise.

Name: Necromancer_keystone_os_kC
Description: Remains your skills detonate pass every ailment their creature died with, for the time it had left, to each enemy the blast hits.

Name: Necromancer_capstone_25
Description: Unlocks at 25 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.
Option1Description: Enemies you or your minions kill have a chance to rise on their own as weak skeletons for 8 seconds, each with a quarter of a husk's health and damage. Each reserves 3 Fervour, so your pool is the limit and there is no separate cap.
Option2Description: One giant you feed remains to over a floor; it grows with each creature's remains and shrinks when hurt.
Option3Description: 1% more damage and 1% less damage taken for each minion alive, up to 20.

Name: Necromancer_capstone_50
Description: Unlocks at 50 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.
Option1Description: Your movement skill can swap places with any of your minions, so your army is your escape route.
Option2Description: Your minions run at the nearest enemy and detonate on contact, and each detonation has a 50% chance to raise a husk that lasts 8 seconds where it went off.
Option3Description: Your skills gain 2% area for each minion alive.

Name: Necromancer_capstone_100
Description: Unlocks at 100 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.
Option1Description: Each time your Fervour reaches its maximum, for 10 seconds your skills deal 50% more damage and each one raises a husk that lasts 8 seconds where it lands.
Option2Description: Damage you take is split evenly between you and your minions.
Option3Description: Each minion gains 5% of your maximum health for every other minion alive.

Name: Necromancer_capstone_200
Description: Unlocks at 200 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.
Option1Description: When you have killed at least 50% of the creatures the floor started with, their remains combine into an Abomination that fights for you until you leave the floor. It reserves 100 Fervour and releases whatever else you have out that would stop it being raised. Its health and damage are a share of every creature killed on the floor so far, and it grows with each kill after it rises, so a floor of Elites makes a stronger one. Creatures a rule keeps sending (rift hunters, Horde waves) do not count toward the 50%. With Lone Revenant, the Abomination has Lone Revenant's 400% more health and damage, and still reserves 100 Fervour.
Option2Description: Your minions cannot die while you are above 50% health.
Option3Description: Whenever you cast a skill, every minion within 10 metres casts it too, at 10% of its damage.

Name: Necromancer_basic_gr_stem0
Description: +1% increased Maximum Health per point, and +1% increased Armor per point for every 5 minions you have, up to 20 minions.

Name: Necromancer_basic_gr_stem1
Description: Your minions within 10 metres of you deal +2% increased damage per point.

Name: Necromancer_basic_gr_stem2
Description: When a hit takes more than 5% of your maximum health, your minions gain +3% increased Attack Speed per point for 4 seconds.

Name: Necromancer_basic_gr_a0
Description: +1% increased Damage Reduction per point while five or more of your minions are within 6 metres of you.

Name: Necromancer_basic_gr_a1
Description: A hit aimed at you has a 3% chance per point to be taken instead by one of your minions within 3 metres of you.

Name: Necromancer_basic_gr_a2
Description: +2% increased Maximum Health per point while you have 10 or more minions.

Name: Necromancer_keystone_gr_kA
Description: Each minion you have alive gives you 1% less damage taken, up to 20%.

Name: Necromancer_basic_gr_b0
Description: At 8 points: 1% of the damage your minions deal is leeched to you as health.

Name: Necromancer_basic_gr_b1
Description: +2% increased Damage Reduction per point for 3 seconds after one of your minions dies within 6 metres of you.

Name: Necromancer_basic_gr_b2
Description: +3% increased Health Regeneration per point while one of your minions has died in the last 3 seconds.

Name: Necromancer_keystone_gr_kB
Description: When one of your minions dies or is detonated, you recover 1% of your maximum health, up to 10% each second.

Name: Necromancer_basic_gr_c0
Description: +2% increased Crowd Control Resistance per point, doubled while five or more of your minions are within 6 metres of you.

Name: Necromancer_basic_gr_c1
Description: Your minions turn on the last enemy that hit you, and deal +3% increased damage per point to it.

Name: Necromancer_keystone_gr_kC
Description: While five or more of your minions are within 6 metres of you, you cannot be stunned, slowed or knocked back.

Name: Shadow_basic_spine_000
Description: Kills generate Fervour: 10 for each enemy you kill, 25 for each Elite or stronger enemy you kill, and 2 for each critical strike you land. While you have this, Fervour drains at 10 per second once 4 seconds have passed since your last kill, so a pause in the killing is what empties it and a full bar means a run of quick kills.

Name: Shadow_basic_spine_001
Description: +2% increased damage per point against Elite and stronger enemies, whose kills fill 25 Fervour rather than 10.

Name: Shadow_basic_spine_002
Description: +3% increased Cooldown Reduction per point for your movement skill.

Name: Shadow_basic_spine_003
Description: For 4 seconds after you kill an enemy, +1% increased Attack Speed and +1% increased Movement Speed per point, so one kill carries you to the next.

Name: Shadow_basic_spine_004
Description: +2% increased Fervour gained from kills per point.

Name: Shadow_basic_spine_005
Description: +1% increased damage per point for every full 20 Fervour you currently hold.

Name: Shadow_basic_spine_006
Description: Fervour drains 5% slower per point once it has begun to drain.

Name: Shadow_basic_spine_007
Description: +1 Fervour per point for each critical strike you land on an Elite or stronger enemy, which keeps the bar up in a long fight where kills are rare.

Name: Shadow_basic_spine_008
Description: Killing an enemy that carries your Poison or Bleed generates +1 Fervour per point.

Name: Shadow_basic_spine_009
Description: For 3 seconds after you use your movement skill, +2% increased Attack Speed per point.

Name: Shadow_basic_spine_010
Description: Each time your Fervour reaches its maximum, your next hit is a critical strike and deals +5% increased damage per point.

Name: Shadow_keystone_spine_001
Description: Fervour drains 6 seconds after your last kill instead of 4.

Name: Shadow_keystone_spine_002
Description: While no enemy is within 20 metres of you, your Fervour does not drain, so a full bar carries from one pack to the next.

Name: Shadow_basic_a_stem0
Description: Your critical strikes have a 6% chance per point to apply Poison and a 6% chance per point to apply Bleed.

Name: Shadow_basic_a_stem1
Description: +3% increased damage over time damage per point.

Name: Shadow_basic_a_stem2
Description: +4% increased duration per point for Poison and Bleed you apply.

Name: Shadow_basic_a_a0
Description: Poison you apply deals +2% increased damage per point. Poison is the long fight's ailment: it pays out in full only against something that survives.

Name: Shadow_basic_a_a1
Description: Poison you apply deals +1% increased damage for every 2 points for each second the enemy has stayed poisoned by you without a break, up to 10 seconds.

Name: Shadow_basic_a_a2
Description: Your hits deal +2% increased damage per point to enemies carrying your Poison.

Name: Shadow_basic_a_b0
Description: Bleed you apply deals +2% increased damage per point.

Name: Shadow_basic_a_b1
Description: +3% increased damage over time frequency per point for Bleed you apply, so more of it lands before a quick kill.

Name: Shadow_basic_a_b2
Description: Bleed you apply deals +3% increased damage per point to enemies more than 4 metres from you, which a bleeding enemy is while it chases you.

Name: Shadow_basic_a_c0
Description: Against a Boss, your damage over time deals +4% increased damage per point.

Name: Shadow_basic_a_c1
Description: Against a Boss, your hits have a 3% chance per point to apply Poison.

Name: Shadow_keystone_a_kA
Description: Increases to your Critical Strike Multiplier also apply to the damage of Poison and Bleed that your critical strikes apply, at half their value.

Name: Shadow_keystone_a_kB
Description: When an enemy bleeding from you dies, the damage its Bleed had left to deal is dealt over 2 seconds to the strongest enemy within 10 metres (the enemy Deathmark marked, if you have Deathmark).

Name: Shadow_keystone_a_kC
Description: Against a Boss, your damage over time ticks also count as kills for filling Fervour, once every 2 seconds.

Name: Shadow_basic_b_stem0
Description: +3% increased Critical Strike Chance per point.

Name: Shadow_basic_b_stem1
Description: +4% increased Critical Strike Multiplier per point.

Name: Shadow_basic_b_stem2
Description: +3% increased damage per point against Bosses, where no kill comes to reset or refill you.

Name: Shadow_basic_b_a0
Description: +3% increased Critical Strike Multiplier per point against enemies below 50% health.

Name: Shadow_basic_b_a1
Description: Killing an enemy with a critical strike restores 1% of your Maximum Health for every 2 points.

Name: Shadow_basic_b_a2
Description: +3% increased damage per point against enemies below 30% health.

Name: Shadow_basic_b_b0
Description: +3% increased Critical Strike Chance per point for hits that strike an enemy from behind, including hits a skill counts as struck from behind.

Name: Shadow_basic_b_b1
Description: +1% increased damage for every 2 points for each hit in a row you have landed on the same enemy, up to 10 hits.

Name: Shadow_basic_b_b2
Description: +2% increased Critical Strike Chance per point against Elite and stronger enemies, and against the enemy Deathmark marked, if you have Deathmark.

Name: Shadow_basic_b_c0
Description: Against a Boss, each critical strike takes 1 second for every 4 points off your movement skill's remaining cooldown.

Name: Shadow_basic_b_c1
Description: While you have hit a Boss in the last 2 seconds, Fervour drains 8% slower per point.

Name: Shadow_keystone_b_kA
Description: You deal 100% more damage against enemies below 30% health.

Name: Shadow_keystone_b_kB
Description: The strongest enemy within 15 metres is marked. It takes 30% more damage from you, and each critical strike on it gives 5 Fervour. When it dies, the mark moves to the strongest enemy within 10 metres.

Name: Shadow_keystone_b_kC
Description: Against a Boss, every 10th hit you land counts as killing an Elite or stronger enemy, for Fervour and for everything else that happens when you kill.

Name: Shadow_keystone_b_kD
Description: Requires Deathmark. You mark two enemies.

Name: Shadow_basic_c_stem0
Description: +1% increased Movement Speed per point, doubled for 4 seconds after a kill.

Name: Shadow_basic_c_stem1
Description: Hits you land within 1 second after your movement skill ends deal +3% increased damage per point.

Name: Shadow_basic_c_stem2
Description: +3% increased range per point for your movement skill, doubled for 2 seconds after a kill, so the jump after a kill reaches the next target.

Name: Shadow_basic_c_a0
Description: Your movement skill deals +4% increased damage per point.

Name: Shadow_basic_c_a1
Description: Killing an enemy within 2 seconds of using your movement skill generates +1 Fervour per point.

Name: Shadow_basic_c_a2
Description: +3% increased Critical Strike Chance per point for your movement skill.

Name: Shadow_basic_c_b0
Description: Enemies your movement skill hits take +2% increased damage per point from you for 4 seconds.

Name: Shadow_basic_c_b1
Description: Each enemy your movement skill hits generates 1 Fervour for every 2 points.

Name: Shadow_basic_c_b2
Description: Your movement skill's hits have a 5% chance per point to apply Bleed. An enemy you leave bleeding behind you has to chase you, and Bleed deals its damage while it moves.

Name: Shadow_basic_c_c0
Description: Your movement skill can be used while it is on cooldown by spending 40 Fervour, reduced by 2 per point.

Name: Shadow_basic_c_c1
Description: +5% increased Cooldown Reduction per point for your movement skill while you hold 50 or more Fervour.

Name: Shadow_keystone_c_kA
Description: Killing an enemy resets your movement skill's cooldown (with Deathmark: killing the marked enemy also gives 10 Fervour).

Name: Shadow_keystone_c_kB
Description: Your movement skill passes through enemies and hits each one.

Name: Shadow_keystone_c_kC
Description: Your movement skill has one more charge, and anything that resets its cooldown restores every charge.

Name: Shadow_capstone_25
Description: Unlocks at 25 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.
Option1Description: Your first hit on an enemy at full health is a critical strike that deals 50% more.
Option2Description: A shadow of you stays where your movement skill started and repeats your next attack.
Option3Description: +3% increased Movement Speed for every 10 Fervour held.

Name: Shadow_capstone_50
Description: Unlocks at 50 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.
Option1Description: Each kill throws a spectral blade at the strongest enemy within 10 metres (the enemy Deathmark marked, if you have Deathmark) for 100% weapon damage, so the next fight starts before you arrive.
Option2Description: Every third kill of an Elite or stronger leaves a clone of you that fights for 5 seconds with your basic attack.
Option3Description: +1% critical strike chance for every 10 Fervour held.

Name: Shadow_capstone_100
Description: Unlocks at 100 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.
Option1Description: Your movement skill can target any enemy within 15 metres that you can see and puts you behind it.
Option2Description: A kill makes your next hit within 2 seconds a critical strike.
Option3Description: Each kill takes 1 second off all your skill cooldowns for every 100 Fervour held.

Name: Shadow_capstone_200
Description: Unlocks at 200 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.
Option1Description: Each kill moves you straight to the strongest enemy within 10 metres (the enemy Deathmark marked, if you have Deathmark) and strikes it.
Option2Description: Your hits kill a non-Boss enemy below 15% health outright; Bosses take double damage from you below 15%.
Option3Description: Your hits strike again once for every 10 Fervour held, up to 10 extra strikes.

Name: Shadow_basic_d_stem0
Description: After you evade a hit, your next hit within 3 seconds is a critical strike.

Name: Shadow_basic_d_stem1
Description: +1% Evasion chance per point, and +5% increased Critical Strike Multiplier per point for the critical strike an evasion gives you.

Name: Shadow_basic_d_stem2
Description: +3% increased Evasion chance per point.

Name: Shadow_basic_d_a0
Description: +1% Evasion chance per point against attacks from Elite and stronger enemies.

Name: Shadow_basic_d_a1
Description: Each evasion has a 5% chance per point to give you two critical strikes rather than one.

Name: Shadow_basic_d_a2
Description: Evading a hit generates 1 Fervour per point, or 2 per point if the attacker is Elite or stronger.

Name: Shadow_keystone_d_kA
Description: When you evade a melee hit, you strike the attacker back at once with your basic attack.

Name: Shadow_basic_d_b0
Description: +3% increased Evasion chance per point while you are moving.

Name: Shadow_basic_d_b1
Description: For 2 seconds after you use your movement skill, +3% Evasion chance per point.

Name: Shadow_basic_d_b2
Description: For 3 seconds after you evade a hit, +2% increased Movement Speed per point.

Name: Shadow_keystone_d_kB
Description: While you are moving, your Evasion chance also applies to area damage, at half its value.

Name: Shadow_basic_d_c0
Description: +1% Evasion chance for every 2 points for every full 20 Fervour you currently hold.

Name: Shadow_basic_d_c1
Description: Evading a hit adds 1 second for every 3 points to the time before your Fervour begins to drain.

Name: Shadow_keystone_d_kC
Description: Evading a hit takes 1 second for every 5 points off your movement skill's remaining cooldown.
